_meta.directives: Dossier fondé sur des sources externes, dont plusieurs communautaires ; ne pas étendre les affirmations sans source dédiée.

linguisticReconstructions.claim: A Soninke community list attaches two second names (jammu kare), Djadja and Bidanesse, to Marega, and contributors to a Soninke community forum place it among the names of Soninke origin.

The same contributors point out that many names borne today by Soninke people are not originally Soninke: the attachment of Marega to the Soninke remains a community attribution, with no other source.

sources.title: Les noms de famille avec leur jammu kare
sources.notes: Soninke community portal, a social organisation page with no identified academic author: a non-exhaustive list, compiled by the portal's users, of the second names (jammu kare) given to Soninke family names. The jammu kare is, the page says, the second name added to a family name and serving as its identifier. Consulted in an archived copy of 12 December 2024. We take from it only the presence of the name in the list and its second names: the list says nothing about their origin.

sources.title: Les noms de Famille d'Origine Soninké
sources.notes: Discussion thread on the forum of the Soninkara.com community portal, opened in December 2006 and continued until 2011: contributors, under pseudonyms, compile lists of names they hold to be Soninke. The lists partly overlap and contradict one another: several participants point out that many names borne today by Soninke people are not originally Soninke, and one of them asks that Soninke names be distinguished from names of Soninke origin. Consulted in an archived copy from 2024.

sources.title: Marega — origine, signification et incidence du nom de famille
sources.notes: Worldwide genealogy aggregator, consulted on 29 September 2026. Worldwide incidence of about 14,397 bearers; Mali 5,098, Guinea 1,510, Senegal 1,497, Italy 1,391, Brazil 1,078, Argentina 1,050. The page gives no meaning for the name. The figures for countries outside Africa are not carried into the attestations of this fiche.
